feeding_claim.verbatim: We are now (2025) offering a limited number of grass finished beef.

notes: Jake and Crystal Bigelow, Hereford cattle near Winterset in Madison County, south-central Iowa. Read beef, pork, buy, contact and our farm pages (WebFetch summaries only, so the Verifier should recheck the verbatim quote). Category both: beef page says cattle go on a hay and Non-GMO corn diet until finished at about 17 to 18 months, and separately offers a limited number of grass finished beef, which it says still get some grain during weaning (could arguably be percentage). Cows graze rotationally on rented pasture. Pigs are fed farm-grown Non-GMO corn and soybean meal in converted grain bins with outdoor paddocks, not pasture. Beef sold by the whole, half or quarter, pork by the whole or half; reservations by online or mailed order form, meat picked up at Story City Locker. No retail cuts, delivery or shipping found. Second phone (Crystal) 515-493-9206. Free-range laying hens mentioned on the farm page but eggs not offered for sale.
